payload.name: LMFDB_EC_RANK_TRUST_TIER_CONFLATION
payload.false_form: All elliptic curve rank values in LMFDB are analytically proven via descent and Selmer-group machinery and may be treated as ground truth in any training corpus.
payload.true_form: LMFDB canonical elliptic curve rank values split by trust tier: rank 0 and rank 1 cases are typically ANALYTICALLY_PROVEN unconditionally via descent algorithms (mwrank) and Kolyvagin's theorem equating analytic and algebraic rank. Higher rank cases (rank >= 2) and curves with non-trivial Tate-Shafarevich group rely on NUMERICALLY_CERTIFIED methods (high-precision L-function evaluation, Heegner-point computation, interval arithmetic) which may be conditional on BSD or parity conjectures. The recent murmuration-based ML-prediction work (RAT dataset, arXiv:2502.10360) produces ML_PREDICTED analytic ranks that exist exclusively in external derivative datasets, NOT in canonical LMFDB. Training corpora that conflate these three trust tiers as one ground-truth field will calibration-poison downstream Learner outputs.
payload.verification_source: Gemini Deep Research pilot DR-S002 2026-05-14; cross-reference LMFDB documentation methodology pages, Kolyvagin 1989, and BBCDLLDOQV (Bieri-Butbaia-Costa-Deines-Lee-Lowry-Duda-Oliver-Qi-Veenstra) 2025 RAT dataset preprint.
